Student Tuition, Fees, and Health Insurance

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 5 of 9).
Tuition Remission on Sponsored Projects
When the Office of Research Administration receives a new Notice of Award, our team reviews the award carefully to determine whether tuition remission is included as part of the project budget. If it is, the next step falls to the ORA Budget Officers, who request a detail code from the Office of Financial Aid. In practice, a detail code acts like the institutional link that tells the system (Banner) where those charges belong. Without that detail code in place, tuition charges cannot be assigned to the project budget in Banner.
Complete the content above before moving on.
DocuSign: Tuition, Fees, and Health Insurance Memo
Please utilize the DocuSign Forms available on ORA's Post Award Forms page.
sm
Detail Code
A project's detail code ties associated participant tuition and fee charges to a given project budget in Banner. ORA Budget Officers ensure the budget code is established at project inception at Morgan State and will add it to any tuition requests submitted through ORA for processing.
School and Department
List the School and Department/Center/Major Program funding these charges.
Contact PI and Title
List the project's PI or PD and their Primary Job Title.
Submission Date
Please enter the date the DocuSign request is submitted.
Semester Covered
Enter the term and year funding will cover for the listed students on the memo.
Project Title
Include the Project Title as written in the project's Notice of Award.
Grant Codes Entry
When an award is established at Morgan the Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) team establishes a string of codes specific to the award. If you are unsure where to locate this information please contact ask.ora@morgan.edu.
Banner Account Code
Tuition, fees, and health insurance costs on awards are charged to the Participant Support Costs (Pool 12) budget level in Banner. Undergraduate charges are entered under 12040 and Graduate charges under 12041.
Contact Individual
While the project's PI may be the contact individual there may be a Program Manager or similarly titled individual working under the PI that could serve as the point of contact.
Participant Information
Include the legal first and last name of each individual, their MSU ID, and the tuition, fees, and health insurance charges (if applicable) covered by the request.
The Office of the Bursar
For information regarding current tuition, fees, and health insurance charges please check out the Bursar's Office webpage here .
Health Insurance
Health Insurance costs for undergraduate students can be paid for directly by the award via this request memo. Graduate students must pay health insurance costs upfront out of pocket and can then receive reimbursement of those expenses via Morgan's Non-Travel Reimbursement Form .
Tuition and fee charges on sponsored awards should be assessed at the in-state rate. If a tuition charge appears at any other rate, the Office of Financial Aid should be contacted so the charge(s) can be reviewed and corrected.
